title: finding(components): 53 lucide identifiers imported as COMPONENTS are not keys of the runtime `icons` record — the half no gate measures
body:
Found while re-verifying the `data-table` readings for objectui#7492 (PR #7829): that renderer imports
`Edit` from `lucide-react` as a component, and `Edit` is one of the retired spellings the icon gate
exists for — `Edit === SquarePen`, the same object under a dead name.

## The reading

`scripts/check-lucide-icon-record-names.mjs` judges icon **NAMES** — authored strings that reach a
resolver reading lucide's runtime `icons` record. Its header states, correctly, that a retired name
"still imports, still type-checks, and still renders wherever it is used as a **COMPONENT**". That is
the argument for the gate's class; it is not a ruling that the component spellings should stay. Nothing
measures them, so here is the measurement.

Scanned 4041 first-party TS sources under `packages/`, `apps/`, `examples/`, collecting every
capitalised identifier in a named import from `lucide-react` and asking whether it is a key of the
runtime `icons` record (lucide 1.31.0, 1767 keys, resolved from `packages/components/package.json`):

**53 distinct identifiers are NOT keys of the record**, across roughly 300 file-usages. The head of the
distribution:

| identifier | files |
|---|---|
| `Loader2` | 85 |
| `AlertTriangle` | 39 |
| `AlertCircle` | 35 |
| `CheckCircle2` | 30 |
| `BarChart3` | 15 |
| `XCircle` | 11 |
| `CheckSquare` | 9 |
| `MoreHorizontal` | 9 |
| `Edit` | 9 |
| `Code2` | 8 |
| `History` | 8 |
| `Home` | 7 |

The tail is 41 more at 1-4 files each (`Filter`, `GanttChart`, `Grid3X3`, `SmilePlus`, `MoreVertical`,
`CalendarIcon`, ...).

## Why it may be worth a line, and why it is NOT the gate's class

- Today nothing is broken: each of these is a live deprecated export pointing at the live glyph, so it
  imports, type-checks and renders.
- The exposure is a lucide major that drops the deprecated exports. That failure is **loud** (a build
  error), which is the opposite of the silent class the icon gate exists for — so this is a
  lower-severity item than anything objectui#5633 and its successors dealt with.
- Second-order: the same repository now authors both spellings — `square-pen` as an authored NAME
  (enforced) and `Edit` as an imported COMPONENT (unenforced). A reader comparing the two cannot tell
  which is current.

## What this issue is NOT asking for

⛔ Not asking to widen `check:icon-record-names`. The split between the NAME surface and the COMPONENT
surface is deliberate and documented in that gate's header, and widening it is a design decision, not a
cleanup. Whether these 53 identifiers get normalised to their live spellings, get pinned, or get an
explicit "accepted, and here is why" line in that header, is a maintainer's call — this card only
records that the population was never measured before and now has been.

Filed unassigned, out of scope for objectui#7492 (PR #7829 changed one census entry in the gate and
added a self-check over that table's `resolver` field; it did not touch this population).
